title: 動名詞與不定詞
point: 動名詞與不定詞題先看空格前面的動詞或介系詞。前面的字決定後面接 V-ing 還是 to V。
formula: 主詞 + 動詞 + V-ing / to V（由前面的動詞決定）

table.rule: 這些動詞後面接 V-ing，不接 to V
後面接 V-ing；recommend 也可以接 that 子句
這些動詞後面接 to V

table.zh: 在做之前、之後、藉由、沒有做
table.rule: 介系詞後面一律接 V-ing
這裡的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing
動詞 + 受詞 + to V

examples: The manager suggested moving the weekly meeting to Thursday afternoon.
The board decided to open a second branch office in Singapore.
story: The sales team planned to visit three clients in Seoul next month.
Their director suggested booking the flights early to save money.
However, the team postponed reserving hotel rooms until the schedule was confirmed.
The travel agent encouraged them to buy travel insurance before leaving.

drills.prompt: Did the team reserve hotel rooms right away?
drills.fix: postponed reserving 表示延後訂房，postpone 後面接 V-ing。

drills.prompt: The director suggested ___ the flights early.
drills.fix: suggest 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V。
encourage 的句型是 encourage + 受詞 + to V。
